reason: My customers ring because they want me, not a text from a machine; an older lady with a leaking pipe isn't going to record a voice note. And nearly 1,000 euros up front plus 149 a month to a company with no customers yet is about 2,800 euros in year one, that's a lot of my margin for something I'm not sure my people will even use.
objection: My customers want to talk to a person, not get a text message. If they get an automatic SMS they'll just call the next plumber on Google.
would_change_my_mind: A colleague from my area with a one-man shop showing me it got him real jobs he would have lost, and no setup fee so I can try it a month and walk away if it doesn't work.
